sections.title: Prism, live
sections.intro: An angular tech cluster: two slanted panels of faceted glass, blue for the reading and red for the revs, with tilted bar scales and a thin neon outline. This is the real wallpaper, drawn in your browser by the app's own code. Tap the big gauge, and try Prism's layouts and colours.

labels.gauge: Tap the big gauge to switch between power, CPU clock and speed, as on your phone.
labels.getNote: A browser can’t set your wallpaper. Get the app on Google Play, open Styles and pick this one.

sections.title: About Prism
sections.intro: Prism is an angular tech cluster: two slanted panels of faceted glass, one blue and one red, with tilted bar scales and a thin neon outline.

items.alt: The Prism style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Prism, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €2.39, once
items.text: Buy Prism once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Prism's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.

image.alt: The Aura style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Aura
items.text: Premium sport dials: chrome rings, a warm glow behind white numerals and big digital numbers, on graphite leather.

image.alt: The Pulse style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Pulse
items.text: A neon HUD of rings: every reading a ring of light around the big number, magenta on black.

image.alt: The Vector style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Vector
items.text: A neon HUD in hexagons: a faceted sweep that thickens as it climbs and crisp thin digits, violet on black.

image.alt: The Horizon style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Horizon
items.text: A fighter jet's head-up display: sliding tapes, the value boxed between them and a time strip, green on black.
